description: This file contains helper functions for testing MAC test modes in a 5G NR simulation environment, including creation of test PDUs with specific RLC and RRC messages, and encoding of UCI (Uplink Control Information) PDUs for different PUCCH formats, with focus on test scenarios involving BSR, RRC setup, and CSI reporting.

methods.name: create_test_pdu_with_bsr
methods.description: Creates a MAC RX data indication with a Long BSR MAC PDU for testing.

methods.name: create_test_pdu_with_rrc_setup_complete
methods.description: Creates a MAC RX data indication with an RRC setup complete message for testing.

methods.name: fill_csi_bits
methods.description: Encodes CSI report bits into a bitset payload based on UE configuration and report type.

methods.name: get_nof_ports
methods.description: Determines the number of CSI report ports based on the report configuration.

methods.name: create_uci_pdu
methods.description: Creates a MAC UCI PDU for different PUCCH formats and scheduled information.

methods.name: pucch_info_and_uci_ind_match
methods.description: Checks if a given pucch_info matches a UCI indication PDU.
